capabilities: Insert external links with prefix syntax like [[w:New York City]]
Define custom quick link prefixes with target URLs
Toggle between wiki-link and Markdown link syntax
Link to other Obsidian vaults via obsidian:// URLs
extras: FAQ covers quirks: quick links appear in graph view unless filtered, and open tabs may show stale rendering until the file is reopened.
problem: Obsidian wikilinks resolve only within the vault, so linking to external sites requires writing full URLs instead of short, memorable prefixed syntax.
summary: Link shortcuts plugin that lets you write [[w:New York City]] to create links to Wikipedia or other sites via custom prefixes.
